storySnippets.narrative: Resolve Freeport's citation at Blackrock. A humanitarian delivery may be the way through.

accepted.title: Permits and filters
accepted.text: Resolve Freeport's citation at Blackrock. A humanitarian delivery may be the way through.

storySnippets.narrative: Your parent places a scorched summons on the workbench. "Blackrock thinks our station needs planning permission. Go sort it out. Take a coat."

storedChoices.label: I'll handle it.
storedChoices.narrative: Your parent hands over the summons. Officer Venn is waiting at Blackrock.

storedChoices.label: Not this time.
storedChoices.narrative: The summons stays on the bench.

storedChoices.label: Why me?
storedChoices.narrative: “Because you have a ship, and because the last person I sent came back with three parking fines.”

storySnippets.secrets: The citation is administratively minor. The parent wants a face-saving resolution, not a confrontation.

accept.text: Your parent hands over the summons. Officer Venn is waiting at Blackrock.

storySnippets.narrative: Venn lowers their voice. "Humanitarian transports get processed today. Glasswake needs three filters. Can you carry them?"

storedChoices.label: Load the three filters.
storedChoices.narrative: Three sealed condenser filters are loaded into your hold.

storedChoices.label: Decline the delivery.
storedChoices.narrative: Venn closes the file.

storedChoices.label: Who are you?
storedChoices.narrative: “Officer Venn. Port compliance. Mostly I keep freight moving and arguments from becoming incidents.”

storedChoices.label: What should I know about Blackrock?
storedChoices.narrative: “Blackrock runs on shipping queues, refinery grit, and forms that breed when nobody is watching.”

storedChoices.label: What exactly are the terms?
storedChoices.narrative: “Three sealed condenser filters to Glasswake Clinic. The permit follows once I have their receipt. Any payment from the clinic is between you and them.”

storySnippets.secrets: Venn can use humanitarian transport paperwork to close the citation legally. The filters are genuinely needed.

accept.text: Three sealed condenser filters are loaded into your hold.

storySnippets.narrative: "Environmental inspection. Transfer the filters." The clinic whispers that this is a protection racket. You can refuse and fight, or attempt another response.

storedChoices.label: Refuse and prepare to fight.
storedChoices.narrative: Second Notice powers its weapons.

storedChoices.label: Pay 5 credits for passage.
storedChoices.narrative: The clerk accepts five credits and clears the approach. The filters stay aboard.

storedChoices.label: Who authorized you?
storedChoices.narrative: “Ash Levy handles inspection where official capacity is… delayed.”

storedChoices.label: Back off.
storedChoices.narrative: “Threats are noted as evidence of noncompliance.”

storySnippets.secrets: The Ash Levy has no official inspection authority. Its clerk prefers an easy fee to a dangerous fight.

passage.text: The clerk accepts five credits and clears the approach. The filters stay aboard.

storySnippets.narrative: Seli points toward the silent ventilation room. "Those filters could make quite a difference. Shall we unload them?"

storedChoices.label: Unload the three filters.
storedChoices.narrative: The filters are unloaded. Seli pays 20 credits and signs the delivery receipt.

storedChoices.label: Who are you?
storedChoices.narrative: “Seli. I keep the clinic’s air, power, and patience from failing in that order.”

storedChoices.label: How bad is it here?
storedChoices.narrative: “Glasswake is a clinic first and a station second. Everything else is whatever we can keep patched.”

storySnippets.secrets: The clinic is closer to a ventilation shutdown than Seli admits. Delivery requires three actual filters; no payment precedes their transfer.

delivered.text: The filters are unloaded. Seli pays 20 credits and signs the delivery receipt.

storySnippets.narrative: Venn raises the stamp. "Receipt received. One citation ready to close. There is something odd in the sector shipping records, if you are interested later."

storedChoices.label: File Seli's receipt.
storedChoices.narrative: Venn stamps the maintenance permit and pays the 15-credit transport subsidy.

storedChoices.label: What was odd in the shipping records?
storedChoices.narrative: “Enough to be interesting, not enough to make this your problem unless you want another job later.”

storySnippets.secrets: The maintenance permit is legitimate. Venn has noticed suspicious filter orders routed toward a stranded gate; that is a possible future independent job.

filed.text: Delivered the filters and secured Freeport's maintenance permit.

storySnippets.narrative: Your parent sighs over the comm. "We can work this out. Preferably before we have to come get you again." The delivery can be continued later or closed for now.

storedChoices.label: Leave the filters with the relief office.
storedChoices.narrative: Your parent takes custody of the filters for another courier. No delivery payment is claimed.

storedChoices.label: What are my options?
storedChoices.narrative: “Repair, reroute, negotiate, or walk away. Just do one of them on purpose.”

storySnippets.secrets: Recovery has already applied any defeat penalty. Do not repeat it. The filters remain owned until transferred to the relief office.

closed.text: Family relief workers will arrange the remaining delivery.

storySnippets.narrative: A surveyor needs a berth. Her sister offers to fly escort in Good Company.

accepted.title: Good company
accepted.text: A surveyor needs a berth. Her sister offers to fly escort in Good Company.

storySnippets.narrative: Ori taps the atlas. "One crew berth for me. My sister brings her own tender. We will accompany you on local journeys and help in a fight."

storedChoices.label: Welcome aboard.
storedChoices.narrative: Ori joins your crew; Good Company will accompany your ship.

joined.text: Ori joined the crew. Good Company now flies escort.

contacts.name: Freeport Parent
contacts.appearanceBrief: A practical Freeport dockworker-parent in patched station gear, surrounded by tools and half-finished repairs.
contacts.secretInfo: Keep the captain alive, solvent, and only moderately embarrassed.

contacts.name: Officer Venn
contacts.appearanceBrief: A tired Imperial port officer in a soot-marked uniform, carrying too many stamped forms.
contacts.secretInfo: Resolve local compliance problems without creating more paperwork than necessary.

contacts.name: Engineer Seli
contacts.appearanceBrief: A grease-streaked clinic engineer with improvised respirator clips and a tablet full of maintenance alarms.
contacts.secretInfo: Keep Glasswake Clinic operating with scarce parts and minimal drama.

contacts.name: Second Notice Clerk
contacts.appearanceBrief: A severe clerk framed by a battered cutter bridge and a suspiciously official-looking inspection placard.
contacts.secretInfo: Pressure traffic into surrendering cargo under a bureaucratic pretext.

contacts.name: Ori Vale
contacts.appearanceBrief: A young surveyor in an oversized flight jacket, carrying a hand-marked atlas.
contacts.secretInfo: Ori hopes to map a safe route for civilian convoys.
